text:
Nisha (support): FYI we've got an escalation from BrightHealth — they say chat responses suddenly got very short and conservative after last night's rollout. customer provided examples.
Javier (eng): Thanks. Do we have a tenant id / request ids so we can trace?
Nisha (support): tenant brght-001, sample request ids: r_20260312_01, r_20260312_09. Customer says it started ~2026-03-12 02:10 UTC.
Javier (eng): Pulling logs now. Can someone check if sampling defaults were touched in the rollout?
Maya (ml): I can check model config history. It sounds like temp/top_p got lowered. Quick Q: is the app calling with explicit sampling params or relying on defaults?
Nisha (support): Their app doesn't set temp/top_p — they rely on defaults. They attached the request payloads; no sampling fields present.
ops-bot: Audit log entry: 2026-03-12T02:05:11Z by deploy-user 'rodeo-ci' — featureflag "sampling_defaults_v2" set to ON (change id ff-2026-0312-7).
Javier (eng): Confirmed in infra logs. Rolling deployment "rodeo-v2" toggled sampling_defaults_v2 at 02:05:11Z.
Maya (ml): Found the config diff: previous defaults: temperature=0.85, top_p=0.95. New defaults in v2: temperature=0.22, top_p=0.7. That'll make outputs much more conservative.
Nisha (support): Oof. Customer: "Everything used to be more conversational, now it's clipped and refuses to elaborate." They want rollback or workaround.
Sam (prod): Need to assess impact before rolling back. How many customers will this affect if we revert?
Javier (eng): Quick check: ~12k active tenants rely on service-defaults (no explicit sampling). We can opt for a targeted rollback for the flag or patch to preserve v2 but set defaults back.
Maya (ml): Short-term mitigation: patch the default profile to temp=0.8/top_p=0.95 and keep the other perf optimizations in v2. I can open a hotfix.
Nisha (support): Can we also give BrightHealth a temporary workaround they can apply client-side?
Javier (eng): Yes — they can explicitly send sampling params in the request. Example curl we can share:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"conv-4b","input":"<customer prompt>","temperature":0.85,"top_p":0.95}'
```
Nisha (support): Sending that now. Also asked for a short set of example prompts to verify after workaround.
ops-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-1912345678-sampling-defaults. Pager duty notified.
Sam (prod): Maya, can you prioritize the hotfix PR? We should include tests that detect large shifts in output length/entropy on rollout.
Maya (ml): On it. I'll open PR with config rollback for the default profile and add regression checks (entropy and avg token length on a prompt suite).
Javier (eng): I'll gate the flag so we can flip per-region/tenant if needed. For now, schedule a controlled rollback for tenants that reported regressions.
Nisha (support): Update to BrightHealth: provided curl workaround, told them we're investigating and may push a targeted rollback in the next 2 hours. They replied: "Thanks — workaround helps but we'd prefer no service changes on our end."
Sam (prod): Good. Postmortem action: require a canary-run of semantic/regression evals before changing sampling defaults. Add to rollout checklist.
Maya (ml): Added checklist item and a small eval harness. I'll include the test results in PR.
Javier (eng): Deploy plan: flip the flag off for the global rollout, then re-release v2 with corrected default profile. Rolling back at 04:30 UTC unless any objections.
Nisha (support): BrightHealth confirmed they see improvement after manual curl with sampling params.
Sam (prod): No objections. Proceed with rollback path. Keep me posted.
Javier (eng): Rolling flag off now (ff-2026-0312-7 -> OFF). Will watch metrics.
ops-bot: Flag ff-2026-0312-7 set OFF at 2026-03-12T03:18:40Z by javier.
Javier (eng): Metrics: avg response length for clients relying on defaults climbed from 18 tokens back to ~58 tokens within 5 minutes. Latency unchanged.
Nisha (support): Notified customer of rollback and closure. Customer replied :thumbsup: and will monitor.
Sam (prod): Follow-ups: (1) hotfix PR merging default profile change, (2) add pre-rollout semantic regression checks, (3) update deploy playbook to include a sampling-defaults canary.
Maya (ml): I'll draft the PR and include the eval artifacts.
Nisha (support): Closing thread for now, reopening if customer sees new issues. Thanks everyone. :heart:
